CONTENT OPERATIONS Business leaders and teams

Automate Content Ops

Define repeatable AI-assisted content processes that scale. Separate tasks into
automation, human review, and governance.

 Key move Pilot one channel for 2 weeks; measure impact and reviewer effort.

PRACTICAL CHECKLIST

 Use AI to draft briefs and outlines for blogs, social posts, and emails.
 01

 Set templates and prompts for consistent tone, SEO, and brand guidelines.
 02

 Automate content calendars with AI-suggested publish dates and channels.
 03

 Implement human-in-the-loop reviews for final copy and factual accuracy.
 04

 Capture feedback from editors to refine prompts and outputs.
 05

 Pilot one channel for 2 weeks; measure quality, speed, and reviewer effort.
 06

 CAMPAIGN PLANNING Business leaders and teams

AI-Driven Campaign Planning

Translate business goals into AI-assisted briefs and execution plans. Establish
guardrails to keep campaigns on-brand and compliant.

 Key move Limit AI scope to testable elements; escalate high-risk decisions.

PRACTICAL CHECKLIST

 Generate audience segments and personas from CRM and first-party data.
 01

 Create AI-assisted briefs with goals, KPIs, channels, and required assets.
 02

 Propose multichannel plans and A/B test hypotheses with expected lift.
 03

 Auto-create a campaign calendar with drafts, approvals, and asset handoffs.
 04

 Assign ownership to a campaign manager and document decisions.
 05

 Draft multiple ad copy variants and creative prompts for testing.
 06

 Enforce brand and compliance guardrails in prompts and outputs.
 07

 CUSTOMER RESEARCH & REPORTING Business leaders and teams

AI-Enhanced Research & Reporting

Use AI to accelerate insights from customers and automated dashboards. Ensure
human review for interpretation and context.

 Key move Define data sources and success metrics before starting.

PRACTICAL CHECKLIST

 Automate sentiment analysis on surveys, reviews, and social chatter.
 01

 Summarize customer interviews into shareable personas and needs.
 02

 Generate weekly KPI dashboards with automatic data pulls.
 03

 Flag data gaps and anomalies for team review.
 04

 Create narrative-ready executive summaries from analytics outputs.
 05

 Schedule reports to stakeholders with digestible visuals.
 06

 Document data sources, definitions, and update cadence; ensure data lineage (CRM, CMS, AI
 07
